title: Cross-experiment internal/external proxy alignment meta-audit
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: Across completed learned-policy routes, small fresh5k gates and narrow internal anchor improvements are systematically over-optimistic relative to independent fresh20k confirmation, while multi-seed breadth and Standard10 preservation are necessary but not sufficient filters.
material_change: Read completed experiment records only; verify same-policy 5k-to-20k confirmation pairs, summarize internal-pass/external-fail route pairs, quantify optimism/sign consistency, and emit a preregistered protocol recommendation for the next geometric multi-seed training curve. No policy queries or new hands.
baseline: Four known same-policy chains already show 5k-to-20k degradation: legacy iter16 +19.46 to -37.1617, procedural soup +9.0452 to -41.8162, actor raw -9.4188 to -46.5992, and MGDA seed1 -11.11 to -47.525. Standard10 is -11.4275 historical and -24.5683 current bridge at 20k.
notes: This audit will not treat historical summary-only results as weight-level reproducible, will keep execution contracts explicit, and will distinguish undertraining from mechanism or proxy rejection. Recommendations may change experiment scale/gates but cannot claim poker-strength improvement.

attempt01 preserved the initial output before CI-field and training-record lineage repair; attempt02 preserved the output before records_scanned was added. The final run uses the original preregistered exact command and contains the corrected audit.

Promoted 5k pilots are selection-biased; optimism and Pearson statistics diagnose this research process, not an unbiased 5k estimator. Negative <=1M external results are not alone treated as mechanism rejection.

result.summary: Read-only audit scanned 253 experiment records. Five exact same-policy fresh5k-to-fresh20k pairs all ended negative at 20k; both positive 5k pilots failed confirmation. Six internally admitted learned-policy routes, trained across 32,768 to 1,054,555 total route hands, also had negative external 20k point estimates. Corrected CI extraction and training-record lineage accounting are preserved in the final artifacts; 244 tests passed.
result.conclusion: Small selected fresh5k gates and narrow internal-anchor admission were not reliable external-strength proxies in this research history. Multi-seed breadth and source preservation remain useful necessary filters but are insufficient. This rejects the prior admission protocol, not conflict-aware learning itself nor longer training solely because budgets were <=1M.
result.next_step: Inventory and freeze a genuinely heterogeneous six-plus-opponent training league and at least three gradient-untouched holdouts, then preregister a three-seed 65,536-to-262,144-to-1,048,576 geometric learned-weight curve with robust median checkpoint selection and no fresh5k selection.
